package.description: Cross-platform (macOS / Linux / Windows) process resource monitor written in Rust.

en-US.description: Cross-platform (macOS / Linux / Windows) process resource monitor written in Rust.
en-US.longDescription: zoio lets you pick running processes via a checkbox list or match them with regex patterns, then watches their CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network I/O in real time. All matched subprocesses are followed automatically. Metrics are drawn as four live plots (one per resource) that can be viewed per-process, combined, or grouped. When you stop the session, the full capture is exported to CSV.
en-US.name: zoio
